shortDescription: Manage port mirroring configuration on SONiC.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the operation to be performed on the mirroring configured on the device. In case of merged, the input configuration will be merged with the existing configuration on the device. In case of deleted, the input configuration will be removed from the device. In case of overridden, all existing mirroring configuration will be deleted and the specified input configuration will be added.
